name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
short_description: Collateral-free institutional business loans up to Rs. 10 Lakh (extended to Rs. 20 Lakh) for micro and small enterprises.
detailed_description: PMMY provides loans up to Rs. 10 Lakh (and up to Rs. 20 Lakh under Tarun Plus category) to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. Classified into three categories: Shishu (loans up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (loans Rs. 50,001 to Rs. 5 Lakh), and Tarun (loans Rs. 5 Lakh to Rs. 10 Lakh).
description_kannada: ಸಣ್ಣ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಸ್ಥರು, ಉದ್ಯಮಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಯಂ ಉದ್ಯೋಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಅಡಮಾನವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ರೂ. 50,000 ದಿಂದ ರೂ. 10 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಸಾಲ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Minimum Age 18
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your current age in years?

benefits_summary: Collateral-free loans up to Rs. 10 Lakh with affordable interest rates and Mudra RuPay card.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card)
Business registration / enterprise quotation / project report
Bank statement for the last 6 months
application_process: Apply online through the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank, RRB, or MFI.
Select appropriate loan category: Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun.
Submit business proposal and identity documents.
Loan is processed and sanctioned without requiring collateral security.
source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd (MUDRA), Govt of India
source_excerpt: Under the aegis of PMMY, MUDRA has created products for funding micro enterprises at various stages of growth.
